manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp225 and 476-478 describes ItemTransfer, IN via STFID=<OUTSIDE>, actual nominal/on-hand update at transfer, priority over ordinary demands, and TFDT optional; pp445-447 distinguishes nominal STSIZ from on-hand. Installed table dictionary defines seven ItemTransfer columns in key order. Manual pp682-684 and 717 state item-position STSZ/STOHA time-series require Item.TRACK=Y; the dictionary defines TRACK as Y/N with default N.
controlled_design: One ItemTransfer row schedules one TEACH-LRU-01 from <OUTSIDE> into DEPOT-01 at h4 with TFDT0. E04 FAST has BASE stock0/DEPOT stock1. A third ResultCollection row requests ITEM half-hour results, and Item.TRACK=Y requests collection for the LRU; these two report controls are intended to expose STSZ/STOHA. Parent tasks, two-hour general support link, depot repair, seed1, missions and 36h horizon remain fixed. No ItemReorder business rows. Earlier v1.0.0 and v1.0.1 diagnostics showed physical arrival at h4; v1.0.1 lacked item-position tables and is not the publication candidate.

pre_run_hypotheses.transfer: Earlier sealed diagnostics showed one transfer arrival and physical DEPOT stock1→2 at h4. In this separately frozen v1.0.2 run, Item.TRACK=Y with ITEM ResultCollection should expose ItemPositionResults time-series with DEPOT STSZ/STOHA equal1 before h4 and 2 after h4, while physical transfer and source/closure fingerprints stay stable. Exact native report table name and row structure are conditional.
pre_run_hypotheses.later_demand: The later ordinary failure should be served by the existing E04 demand-support route; exact failure draw, item identity, demand timing, mission outcomes and report values remain conditional. Planned transfer and demand-triggered support are separate mechanisms.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter rejection, absent item-position result/STSZ/STOHA despite tracking, no native transfer event, stock/report mismatch, transfer duplication or changed source fingerprint is diagnostic; no positive nominal IN claim is published. Preserve contrary outcome.
